title: 第2110章 相逢于微末第2109章 炼器宫炸了
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 昊天圣地的众多大佬并没有人关心欧阳明是否受伤的问题……这其中也包括楚星河！
虽然欧阳明成就神师以来从没跟人过过招，但是神师永远是神师，欧阳明的身体强度那绝对是不用说的。
这眼前的爆炸虽然把整个炼器室都给炸成了废墟，但是说实话，这个爆炸的程度你连伤个九品估计都费劲，更何况是欧阳明了呢！
虽说如此，但是炼器宫的众多欧阳家的弟子还是在第一时间从废墟之中把欧阳明给扒拉了出来。
果然，被扒拉出来的欧阳明完全没有任何损伤……
除了浑身黢黑之外，连特么一根头发丝都没有伤到啊……
而这会儿浑身黢黑的欧阳明露着一口小白牙在那边儿哈哈哈的笑着……
而傻乐的欧阳明怀里还抱着一只巨大的银盘，这会儿有欧阳家的弟子想要上前搀扶欧阳明，也有弟子想要从欧阳明怀里把那银盘给接过去。
可是刚碰到那银盘，欧阳明嗖的一下子就躲开了！
“别碰！”欧阳明此时一脸紧张！
看到这一幕别说是其他人了，连现场欧阳家的弟子们都懵了……
要知道，别的地方神器啥的值钱不值钱咱不知道哈，但是在昊天圣地的炼器宫里面，就数神器这玩意儿不值钱！
上个月听说欧阳明勃然大怒，一度惩罚了整个炼器宫所有的弟子！
理由是，他藏起来的半盆冷面被人偷吃了！
对此欧阳明拿着那饭盆表示这绝对是家贼做的！
什么玩意儿？你说欧阳明凭什么这么说？
因为那饭盆乃是神器级的……
这特么要不是家贼都有鬼了……
你见过谁家偷东西的，把神器扔地上，把神器里面的冷面全吃了的？
所以这绝对是家贼。
欧阳明表示千防万防家贼难防啊！
这里放着一百多件儿各种的神兵利器，这个家贼连看都没有多看一眼，他是径直走到我欧阳明的冷面面前，他良心大大滴坏了啊！
他无视了所有的神兵利器，他的目标只有一个，那就是我欧阳明的冷面！
不管是谁偷吃了我欧阳明的冷面，现在你站出来，你站出来我既往不咎……但如果被我查出来，你等着吧！
最后终究还是没有人承认吃了欧阳明冷面这件事！
没办法，炼器宫的弟子都知道，这事儿可太特么大了！
今天你要说炼器宫谁谁谁炼制神器连续失败了几十次，浪费了无数材料，那他最多被欧阳明数落半上午，然后下午滚去继续修炼！
而今天你要说谁谁谁从欧阳明的宝库之中拿走了三五十件儿神器私用了，欧阳明知道以后最多就是罚你马上编造一个合情合理的理由也就完了！
可你要说今天谁偷吃了欧阳明的冷面，那可是有可能被送入土木系的！
这简直太可怕了好吧！
毕竟杀人不过头点地啊，死有什么可怕，死不就是两眼一闭吗？
可是送入土木系算怎么回事儿？如果说要被送入土木系，那不如直接死了多好！
所以在炼器宫这旮沓，神器什么的真的不值钱。
content_en:
;;
No one in the Haotian Holy Land cares about whether Ouyang Ming is injured... including Chu Xinghe!
Although Ouyang Ming has never fought against anyone since he became a divine master, a divine master will always be a divine master. Ouyang Ming's physical strength is absolutely needless to say.
Although the explosion in front of you reduced the entire refining room to rubble, to be honest, the magnitude of the explosion would probably make it difficult for you to even injure a ninth-level person, let alone Ouyang Ming!
Despite this, many Ouyang family disciples in the Weapon Refining Palace immediately pulled Ouyang Ming out from the ruins.
Sure enough, Ouyang Ming was pulled out without any damage at all...
Apart from being completely black, not even a single hair was damaged...
At this moment, Ouyang Ming, who was covered in black, was smiling hahaha with his small white teeth exposed...
The silly Ouyang Ming was still holding a huge silver plate in his arms. At this moment, some disciples of the Ouyang family wanted to step forward to help Ouyang Ming, and some wanted to take the silver plate from Ouyang Ming's arms.
But as soon as he touched the silver plate, Ouyang Ming swooped away!
"Don't touch!" Ouyang Ming looked nervous at this time!
Not to mention everyone else, even the disciples of the Ouyang family were stunned when they saw this scene...
You know, we don’t know whether artifacts are valuable in other places, but in the Artifact Refining Palace of Haotian Holy Land, artifacts are worthless!
Last month I heard that Ouyang Ming was furious and once punished all the disciples in the entire Weapon Refining Palace!
The reason is that half of the cold noodles he hid was eaten by someone!
In response, Ouyang Ming took the rice bowl and said that this was definitely done by a domestic thief!
What the hell? Why do you think Ouyang Ming said that?
Because that rice bowl is an artifact level...
If it wasn't for the thieves, all the thieves would be ghosts...
Have you ever seen someone steal something, throw the artifact on the ground, and eat all the cold noodles in it?
So this is definitely a house thief.
Ouyang Ming said that it is difficult to guard against domestic thieves!
There are more than a hundred magic weapons of various kinds placed here. This thief didn't even take a second look. He walked straight to my cold face, Ou Yangming. His conscience was greatly damaged!
He ignored all the magic weapons and had only one target, and that was my cold face, Ou Yangming!
No matter who secretly ate my Ouyang Ming's cold noodles, now you stand up, I will forgive you if you stand up... But if I find out, just wait!
In the end, no one admitted to eating Ouyang Ming’s cold noodles!
There is no way, all the disciples in the Refining Palace know that this matter is too big!
Today, if you want to tell someone in the Artifact Refining Palace who has failed to refine artifacts dozens of times in a row and wasted countless materials, then he will be scolded by Ouyang Ming for at most half the morning, and then go away and continue practicing in the afternoon!
And today you are going to say that so-and-so took thirty or fifty artifacts from Ouyang Ming's treasure house for personal use. Ouyang Ming will punish you and make up a reasonable reason right away, and that's it!
But if you want to say who ate Ouyang Ming's cold noodles today, they might be sent to the Department of Civil Engineering!
This is simply too scary!
After all, killing can only be done with a nod of the head. What's so scary about death? Isn't death just a matter of closing your eyes?
But what if I was sent to the Department of Civil Engineering? If you want to be sent to the civil engineering department, it would be better to just die!
So in the Refining Palace, artifacts are really worthless.
